Fix applied (min 3 informative tokens), map regenerated, all three pairs confirmed excluded, sample re-verified. Semantics of the surviving mid-band (0.55-0.6) matches spot-confirmed sound (energy-level vs reaction-pathway diagrams; chromatogram interpretation).
